name: Edgar Pelayo
office: City of South Gate, Member of the City Council

items.text: Edgar Pelayo is on the November 2026 ballot for South Gate City Council. A 2023 city council agenda described him as a business consultant. He has served on the Parks and Recreation Commission since 2023. His campaign site lists fiscal responsibility, transparency and trust as priorities, with a focus on maximizing tax dollars.
